findings.title: Task tool accepts primary agents without enforcing subagent-only usage
findings.rationale: Task tool lists only non-primary agents in its description, but the executor only checks that the agent exists, so a primary agent name can still be passed and used.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate agent.mode before execution (reject primary), or normalize subagent_type to known non-primary agents.

findings.title: Task tool falls back to parent message model when subagent has no model
findings.rationale: If a subagent lacks a model config (or it wasn't loaded), TaskTool uses the parent assistant message's model, which matches the current primary agent/model.
findings.suggested_fix: Require explicit model for subagents or add logging when falling back to parent model.

findings.title: Commands can force subtasks with primary agents, creating Task calls for the current agent
findings.rationale: When a command has subtask: true (e.g., /review), the system creates a subtask even if the agent is primary, so the Task tool runs with the current agent/model.
findings.suggested_fix: Set command.agent to a subagent or set subtask: false for primary-only commands.
